title: Nora and the Stiff Treehouse Latch
youtube_title: Nora and the Stiff Treehouse Latch | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice that asks for help at the right moment.
summary: Nora wants to join the afternoon story in the oak treehouse, but the latch is stiff and she feels shy about asking, so she climbs the last steps and asks for help, and together they open the door.
